description: Routing evals for external node, MCP, process trigger lifecycle, and Wasm host protocols.

cases.prompt: Change node.exec.v2 subprocess JSON-RPC to use a different method name.
expectations: Distinguishes manifest entrypoint from JSON-RPC method
Preserves current host truth around node.execute

cases.prompt: Add a new remote source catalog entry to chainbot-plugin-index.toml.
cases.expected_output: Should not load this skill; prefer decision-chainbot-plugin-source-install if install/source policy changes.
expectations: Does not route catalog-only changes to host protocol

cases.prompt: Change plugin install --force backup and rollback behavior.
cases.expected_output: Should not load this skill; prefer decision-chainbot-plugin-source-install.
expectations: Keeps install lifecycle separate from execution protocol

cases.prompt: Keep a WebSocket trigger child blocked inside the daemon poll loop and call it process_short_lived.
expectations: Makes the supervisor own child cancellation and cleanup

cases.prompt: Change the Wasm trigger guest callback ABI or migrate trigger-plugin.wit bindings.
expectations: Treats WIT Component Model bindings as the ABI authority
Keeps the core-Wasm ABI only as temporary compatibility
